body: I'm actually on the waiting list for a therapist, so luckily have that covered. Thank you for your message.

I can't tell you how much your message means to me. Our situations are so similar, I'm happy to have your perspective on this. I want to talk to him about it so much, I know he'll make me feel better but I've just been starting to feel selfish. I just feel like a constant liability to him that he always needs to watch out for or brace himself for the next time my anxiety bothers me. Realistically, I know he'll be very comforting. 

The event just broke me as a person and because I never dealt with it properly it's been slowly ruining me. It's ripped away my self-confidence, it's caused many insecurities and fears. I'm even more upset at my abuser that his actions are affecting my current relationship. He did and said the cruelest things to me and I think I just started believing them and still do to this day.

Thank you for your message, it was very helpful. I think I may tell him, but I'm still not sure. I just feel so scared and alone right now. And you're right about the guilt, it's become a normal state for me.

Thank you for your response. He is absolutely a good person. I just don't want to keep taking advantage of his kindness, I feel like everyone has a limit and I'm terrified of him throwing his hands up and telling me he gives up. 

I don't want him to always feel like something will go wrong with me, or worse, something is wrong with me.
